training.title: GRAK'S RECRUITS
training.safe: The road is quiet. Take your time placing the recruit; waves resume after you build.
training.starting_gold: Your starting gold is ready. Gunners cost 50 each.
training.plan: Place a defender to resume. Waves advance automatically; p pauses, n sends one early.
training.locked: This defender joins later. Your available recruits can handle the next wave.
training.gunner: Start with Gunners near the entrance. They shoot one fighter at a time. Two covering the same stretch make a dependable opening. Use arrows or WASD to move, 1 to choose, and Enter or click to place.
training.frost: Put a Frost Mage beside your Gunners. Slowing a fighter gives every nearby defender more time to shoot. Frost also stops Rogues evading their bullets. You will have frost before the first Rogues arrive.
training.cannon: The Cannonier catches several fighters in one explosion. Cover a stretch where frost bunches them together. Explosions ignore Rogue evasion and punch through Paladin plate.
training.ranger: Rangers cover a much longer stretch of road. Select one and press t to choose its targets; strongest helps against tough fighters. Arrows are especially useful against Centurion magic wards.
training.slingers: Gnoll Slingers are cheap, quick shooters with short reach. Put them close to the road to cover a gap. Frost helps their stones hit Rogues; use cannons against heavy plate.
training.lightning: Lightning Mages hit a fighter and jump to others nearby. Dense groups give the spell more targets. Keep physical damage nearby: Centurion wards resist lightning.
training.trebuchet: Trebuchets throw slowly, but their wide explosions reach far across the chamber. Aim their coverage at returning lanes and crowded bends. Frost helps keep a crowd inside the blast.
training.runeforge: Keep a normal opening defense; all seven main defenders are available. The Runeforge adds a beam that burns every fighter in a straight line. Use [ ] for specialists, 1 to choose it, and r to turn the preview. Aim down a road; frost keeps fighters in the heat. One per level.
training.hookmaster: The Ogre drags fighters backward along the road. Put him beside a strong defense so they have to cross it again. Heavy fighters move less, and every fighter eventually resists further pulls. One per level.
training.sappers: Sappers plant mines on nearby road tiles. They prepare stock between waves; p pauses the action if you need more planning time. Explosions ignore plate and evasion. Recruits can waste the stock; selling the crew removes its mines. One per level.
training.witch: The Witch marks a fighter to take more damage from your other defenders. She starts on strongest targeting. Put her beside damage dealers: she does not attack on her own, and marks do not stack. One per level. Waves advance automatically; p pauses them.
training.next_defense: Specialists join during your second defense, after holding the Rotunda.
training.after_wave: This recruit joins after wave {wave}. Earned recruits stay available on retries.
